subject.title: Discord plugin does not auto-reconnect after 1006 WS close (forces full gateway restart, kills in-flight turns)

question: Is the July 2026 live field evidence plus current source enough to sponsor a new Discord gateway recovery repair, or should maintainers require a current-main lifecycle trace that identifies the state transition first?
rationale: A previous direct PR for abnormal-close recovery had strong field logs but was closed unmerged because the production-reachable transition was not proven; the issue now has newer release evidence, but the exact current-main root cause remains unisolated.

options.title: Require A Current-Main Lifecycle Trace
options.body: Keep the issue open for live or harness proof that captures the gateway state before the 1005/1006 close, the reconnect attempt or missing attempt, and why the channel stays dead.

options.title: Sponsor A Chokepoint Mitigation
options.body: Accept that the close handler is the practical recovery boundary and ask for a narrow repair with promoted diagnostics and live Discord proof before merge.

options.title: Add Operator Reconnect Fallback First
options.body: Prioritize a channel-scoped Discord reconnect command as a mitigation while leaving automatic recovery root cause work open.

recommendation.title: Require A Current-Main Lifecycle Trace
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open for live or harness proof that captures the gateway state before the 1005/1006 close, the reconnect attempt or missing attempt, and why the channel stays dead.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc provided the maintainer review context on the prior direct abnormal-close PR and is tied to recent Discord reconnect history.
